title: Virtual Acoustic Object 0.5.0 manifest
description: Immutable multimodal scientific virtual-musical-instrument release with exact byte identity, typed provenance, deterministic interaction semantics, physical-system topology, and a linked-data semantic projection.

dateTime.description: RFC 3339 instant in the VAO exact-comparison subset: known offset, seconds 00-59, and at most 18 fractional digits.

numericValue.description: A finite JSON number, numeric vector, or rectangular numeric matrix.

nonNegativeNumericValue.description: A non-negative scalar, vector, or rectangular matrix.

positiveRate.description: A positive clock rate, optionally represented as an exact rational for rates such as 30000/1001.

uncertainty.description: Measurement uncertainty. unit or axisUnits states component units; covariance entries use the products of the corresponding component units. Scalar/vector magnitudes are non-negative; covariance is square, symmetric, and positive-semidefinite as checked semantically.

pose.description: A position in a target frame and, when orientation is present, an explicit local-to-target frame rotation.

processModel.description: A declarative Process. For stochastic Processes, candidates are direct actions in array order followed by direct childProcessIds in array order; exactly one candidate is selected before a selected child expands.

probabilityDistribution.description: Uniform or categorical weights over the zero-based direct candidate sequence, not over recursively flattened descendant actions.

carrierMemberDistribution.description: Locates a realization as an embedded member of another VAO carrier deposited in the same immutable repository release. The member path and byte identity are obtained from that carrier's descriptor and the realization record.

quantityValue.description: A scalar, vector, or rectangular matrix numerical quantity with an explicit unit.

timeScale.description: Absolute IRI identifying the clock's time scale or timecode system.

stream.description: PCG stream selector 0..2^63-1 as fixed-width lowercase hexadecimal.
